name: VibeConnect
tagline: Real-time updates synchronized across Socket.io and REST, so two clients never disagree on state
desc: A full-stack social platform where users build profiles, post updates, and interact in real time. Likes and comments sync instantly across connected clients via Socket.io, with JWT-secured REST APIs behind it.
problem: Most fresher social-app clones stop at CRUD. The goal here was to actually solve the harder part: state that updates live, for every connected user, without a page refresh.

name: CampusCare
tagline: RBAC enforced at the API layer, not hidden in the UI
desc: A campus operations platform with two separate, permission-scoped dashboards. Students and admins see different data and different actions, enforced by role-based access control on every API route, not just hidden in the UI.
problem: Campus services in most colleges still run on paper and WhatsApp groups. This models what a real internal tool for a college looks like — access control, not just a UI, is the actual product.

name: HelperHub
tagline: Request status is a state machine validated server-side — no client can forge a transition
desc: A community help-matching platform: users post requests, helpers respond, and the app tracks each request through its lifecycle — open, claimed, resolved — behind JWT-protected APIs.
problem: Practicing request/response matching and lifecycle state (not just another feed) with the same MERN foundation as VibeConnect and CampusCare, to see the pattern reused in a different domain.

name: AI B2B Textile
tagline: Hub and category are independent, combinable filters — not a forced pick-one-first flow
desc: A B2B marketplace connecting verified fabric suppliers across six Indian textile hubs — Surat, Tiruppur, Ludhiana, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, and Mumbai — with transparent MOQ and pricing, category browsing, and supplier profiles. Live today with 34 real listings across 6 categories.
problem: Textile sourcing in India runs through opaque middlemen and phone calls. This gives buyers transparent pricing and MOQs upfront, and gives suppliers a real storefront by hub and category.
